summary.en: In-development foundation for orbit precision, pointer-anchored navigation, unified object cards, and a corrected camera micro-motion glow awaiting human visual acceptance. Deep Space Phase 4 has not started.
summary.zh-TW: 開發中的軌道精度、游標錨定導航與統一天體字卡基礎，以及等待人類視覺驗收的相機微移動光暈修正；Deep Space Phase 4 尚未開始。
summary.ja: 軌道精度、ポインター基準ナビゲーション、統一天体カード、および人による視覚確認待ちのカメラ微動グロー修正を含む開発中基盤です。Deep Space Phase 4 は未開始です。
summary.ko: 궤도 정밀도, 포인터 기준 탐색, 통합 천체 카드와 사람의 시각 검수를 기다리는 카메라 미세 이동 광원 보정을 포함한 개발 중 기반입니다. Deep Space Phase 4는 시작되지 않았습니다.

changed: Orbit Precision — traceable orbit contracts and rendering for eight planets and eleven representative satellites
Pointer-Anchored Navigation — bounded wheel, trackpad, and mobile-pinch anchor behavior
Unified Object Cards — one evidence-aware model for Solar System, Gaia, Milky Way, and Local Group selections

fixed: Earth-owned visitor and regional markers are suspended before entering Deep Space and guarded against late asynchronous refresh
knownIssues: Foundation Release Audit remains open pending physical Mac trackpad and real-device pinch evidence
Titania lower-hemisphere imagery coverage / projection issue remains deferred
Deep Space Phase 4A–4F have not started
